replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done on 1.1. The sentence is now "Setup takes about a minute." and the list reads: Control the Swarm from the Map (graph icon), Organize agents to reach objectives faster and better (hierarchy icon), Relay is used for inter-session communication (ray icon).

replies.author: User
replies.text:
Fusionar 1.2 y 1.3
Where the M1ND lives
Segunda oración:
"Relay is optimized to run in cloud storage services for free syncing of your preferences"
Directory - que la default sea la de Cosmic (App data creo, fijarse donde escribe: Pathfinder.cs en Vigilum). Se puede cambiar la dirección. como ahí está el Change.
En vez de los dos botones New mind y Existing mind, si detecta una mind instalada, mostrar un banner con un checkbox que diga "Migrate legacy M1ND".

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. 1.2 Where the M1ND lives joins the folder and the sync in one step, so setup has 4 steps. The second sentence is the one given. The folder defaults to the Cosmic root with Change; the board shows AppData\Local\Cosmic\.m1nd until the common Cosmic root is settled with the Overseer (Vigilum's Pathfinder writes to Unity's persistentDataPath\Cosmic, the Cosmic apps use %LOCALAPPDATA%\Cosmic). New mind and Existing mind are gone: when a 2.x M1ND is found, a banner with the Migrate legacy M1ND checkbox appears.

replies.author: User
replies.text: Remove back option, could potentially break installation

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. 1.3 Relay service has no Back, and neither has 1.4 Ready.

replies.author: User
replies.text:
La parte de Sync pedí que se sacara.
No entiendo porqué haríamos una diferenciación en eso, tipo... el directorio que el user elija ya está bien ycontemplado, no hay que avisar nada de eso.
Puede ser, sí, que haya otro banner como el de migrate que diga Use Relay+ (ahora en coming soon) que explique igual que puede usar el mismo servicio de Nebula+ para syncear sus preferencias en cualquier dispositivo. Como un aviso que a futuro ofreceremos ese servicio. Lo tenemos que hablar con el Overseer porque me gustaría que sea super barato... pero bueno no sé cómo hacer. Veremos. Quizá si abrimos github contribuitors y nos donan tienen perk y sino bueno pueden pagarlo en la página de Cosmic.

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. 1.2 has no sync choice: the folder chosen is the sync, since a folder inside a cloud storage service syncs through it. A second banner announces Use Relay+, coming soon: the same service as Nebula+ for preferences on any device. Ready (1.4) and Settings (6.1) no longer show a sync origin; Settings shows Relay+ as coming soon. The pricing idea went to the Overseer.
